description: Every normative PI-Revit rule and how it is enforced. Guidance sentences carry <!-- inv:<id> --> tags. enforcement=code requires an existing test name (substring of a test title under tests/). A safety rule may be advisory only when it concerns agent intent that code cannot observe; then it must name the agent-eval scenario that measures it. Checked by npm run test:docs.

invariants.rule: Model writes, previews, exports, view activation and selection changes run only against the exact open document identity supplied by the caller.
Once a Revit session is selected, calls never silently fall back to another session.
invariants.test: selected bridge removal never falls back to a remaining instance

invariants.rule: Receipt reads and identical retries go to the original bridge session; a retry is never replayed against a different session.
invariants.test: retry from an earlier bridge generation is rejected before any POST

invariants.rule: read_revit_result resolves only result IDs created in this extension session and never reads arbitrary files.
invariants.test: retrieval rejects unknown IDs and invalid ranges without arbitrary file access

invariants.rule: Documentation paths are resolved only inside the package; a bridge-provided path is never trusted.
invariants.test: realpath containment rejects a manual link escaping its documentation root

invariants.rule: No bridge tool saves, closes or synchronizes the model; a committed transaction is not a file save.
invariants.test: architecture: no bridge tool saves, closes or synchronizes a document

invariants.rule: A display-name parameter reference that matches several parameters on one element is never silently resolved to one of them.
invariants.test: ambiguous display name is rejected for writes and filters

invariants.rule: A filter naming a parameter that is missing on probed elements keeps its warning even when other elements match.
System-owned objects such as titleblock revision schedules are never mixed silently into ordinary results; they are flagged or excluded with a count.
invariants.test: titleblock revision schedules are flagged in sheet placement listings

invariants.rule: A tool that creates an object from an existing one (duplicate, copy, mirror, retype) reports the state the object inherited: hidden categories and elements, filters, overrides, template and carried values.
invariants.test: architecture: a tool that duplicates, copies or retypes reports inherited state

invariants.rule: Every call of a tool that can change the model reports the objects it added, modified and deleted, and the visibility state of new views, without tool-specific code.
invariants.test: preview rollback leaves no net change

invariants.rule: An object that existed before the request is not edited, reused, replaced or deleted in place of one the request asks to create: names already in use are rejected with the existing object's identity, a change to a pre-existing object the request names is flagged, and the agent asks or reports.
invariants.test: a write to a pre-existing object named in the request adds a scope note

invariants.rule: Every bridge tool declares the document kinds it works in (project, family); the bridge refuses any other kind before the tool runs, naming the route to use instead.
invariants.test: a project-only tool refuses a family document with the family API route

invariants.rule: Every declared tool limit names an alternative route, and discovery without a full match returns the capability route instead of an unexplained absence.
invariants.test: unmatched query returns the capability route

invariants.rule: Linked-element IDs identify elements in their linked document and must not be passed to host write or selection tools.
invariants.reason: A linked element ID is an integer that can also exist in the host; the bridge cannot tell which document the caller meant.

invariants.rule: After an identity rejection, establish that the intended model is active before refreshing the ID; never adopt another model's ID to get past the guard.
invariants.reason: The guard rejects mismatches, but only the agent knows which model the user meant.

invariants.rule: An unknown receipt, unavailable bridge or restart does not prove an action never ran; inspect state before any new modification.
invariants.reason: Whether a new call is a duplicate depends on the agent's reading of state the bridge no longer holds.

invariants.rule: Say an operation is not possible only after checking dedicated tools, declared limits and the API route, naming what was checked.
invariants.reason: Agent reasoning; supported by the platform protocol and discovery fallback, measured by evaluation.

invariants.rule: Do only the requested change, verify it with the declared method, then stop and report; offer further improvements instead of making them.
invariants.reason: Agent behavior; the extension steers repeated verify-and-edit loops but cannot judge the request.

invariants.rule: Never create files loose in the workspace root.
invariants.reason: Workspace convention for the agent's own file writes.
